children: Wall Street was initially disinterested in prediction markets until they ultimately disrupted the traditional sportsbook sector dominated by DraftKings and Flutter Entertainment's FanDuel, Bank of America analyst Shaun Kelley says at the NEXTPredict summit in New York. They brought in a few advantages that could bypass obstacles that sportsbooks were facing: they could operate in all 50 states, and they could be used by anyone over the age of 18, giving them a broader demographic, Kelley says. (dean.seal@wsj.com)
